Practice rooms and studios are available at the Stephen Riady Centre for activities ranging from dance and drama practices to judo and yoga. To book a practice space for self-practice, please visit [UTown Facilities Booking System](https://utownfbs.nus.edu.sg/utown/apptop.aspx). Press the Help button in the system to access the FBS User Guide for guidelines. Bookings must be made at least 3 days in advance and can be made up to 7 days in advance. Students/staff can book practice spaces for up to 2 hours a day, with a maximum of 3 times a week. Please note that individual bookings are for self-practice or activities involving NUS staff/students only. Users are not allowed to bring in external guests/visitors. External parties interested in booking UTown facilities and/or spaces may approach the [Conferences & Events Management Unit](https://uci.nus.edu.sg/ceu/) via email at ceu@nus.edu.sg.
